title: Registration information – BMW BERLIN-MARATHON
claims: The 2026 BMW BERLIN-MARATHON takes place on 27 September 2026; as with all AbbottWMM events, entries are allocated by lottery, with the lottery open 25 September to 6 November 2025.

Participants aged 18 (age group 2008) and older are admitted; the course must be completed within the 6:15 time limit counted from crossing the start line; walkers are permitted within the limit, Nordic walkers are not.

The 2026 participation fee is 205€; the package includes timing, a four-day public transport ticket in fare zone ABC, a pacemaker for each start wave, the event app, refreshments, medal, personalized e-certificate, finish poncho (or a €5 clothing bag), massage, medical care, showers and changing tents.

Entries are personal and event-related and may not be transferred to another person or year; fees are not refunded without exception, and a cancellation insurance is offered; pregnancy allows a goodwill deferral of up to three years on medical certificate.

Race material is collected only in person at the MARATHON EXPO by BRITA at Messe Berlin, against the start card and a photo ID; no power of attorney is accepted; on race day no clothes, valuables or luggage may be brought to the start/finish area.
